name: Apple Basket

meta.name: Apple Basket
meta.tagline: Move the basket to catch falling apples.
meta.description: Apples fall from above at changing horizontal positions. Slide the basket under them to catch as many as you can before they reach the ground. The observations show the basket and four apple slots, including which slots are active.

rewardTerms.description: Average shaped reward for lining the basket up with falling apples, weighted more strongly as they approach.
Number of apples that reach the ground uncaught.
Fraction of steps spent moving the basket.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Catch apples while avoiding unnecessary movement.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Focus on steady alignment and limit movement.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to move the basket.
